extracted.intended_audience: KIPO examiners and patent applicants/agents requesting expedited examination in the Republic of Korea
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for determining eligibility, required evidence, and examiner procedures for requests for expedited patent examination (Republic of Korea). Covers categories such as government duties, venture/Inno‑Biz certification, practicing as a business, priority claims, and related national projects/certifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition of identicalness for trade-promotion applications without extra evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Where identicalness cannot be determined just based on the documents about the request of expedited examination, an examiner can recognize the request of expedited examination without requiring submission of additional evidential examination as long as there is a high possibility that the application directly related to trade promotion and the claimed invention are the same and no particular grounds to doubt such possibility exist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used when available documents make it highly likely the trade-promotion application and claimed invention are the same; examiner may accept without further proof if no special grounds to doubt exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: applications related to duties of state or municipal governments
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests related to duties of state or municipal governments (including duties of national or public schools and organizations exclusively responsible for tech transfer/commercialization set up in such schools) may be deemed valid only when the requester is the state or municipal government (or such designated organization).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the requester is not a state/municipal government (or designated organization), examiner shall deem the request invalid and order correction within designated period; if not corrected, dismiss the request. National/public school and designated organizations have specific definitions and must be legal entities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venture business — joint filing acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: Where an application is jointly filed and one of the applicants is a venture business (certified under the relevant Act), the request for expedited examination shall be accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Joint filings that include at least one certified venture business qualify; examiner should verify certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venture business — identical-name acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the names of the company certified as a venture business and the applicant are identical, the request for expedited examination shall be accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name identity is sufficient for acceptance; if names differ other rules (see handling) apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venture business — timing: validity period requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: At least one of the dates among the filing date, the date of request of expedited examination, or the date of determination on expedited examination shall be within the valid period written on the certificate of being a venture business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner must check the certificate validity period; request fails if no relevant date falls within certificate validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venture business — required evidence of certification
rubrics_metrics.description: The original copy of the confirmation of being a venture business shall be used to verify the status; a copy can be used if recognized to be the same. A written notice on the result of evaluation cannot replace the confirmation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original confirmation preferred; copies acceptable only when demonstrably identical; evaluation notices are insufficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venture business — relevance/correlation requirement between business type and claimed invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Where there is no correlation between the type of the venture business and the claimed invention, the request for expedited examination shall not be accepted. If no correlation is found, examiner shall order correction; if correlation is well explained, accept the request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correlation examined based on written explanation and evidential documents (e.g., business registration); examiner may consult company overview or the venture confirmation website (http://www.venturein.or.kr/) to compare business type and claimed invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venture business — when certified company on confirmation is not the applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: If the company written on the venture confirmation is not an applicant, examiner shall deem the application filed by a venture business and recognize the request only when the applicant and the head of the venture business indicated on the confirmation are the same. For a natural-person applicant, the venture business at filing time shall not be a legal entity, in addition to applicant/head identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If different, examiner orders submission of business registration certificate to determine legal-entity status. Method: second group numbers in registration number 81-87 indicate legal entity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venture business — addition after filing: no retroactive eligibility (except narrow exceptions)
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible on the ground of venture business, the applicant shall be a venture business when filing an initial application. Adding a venture business after filing does not make the application eligible for expedited examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exception: where the venture business practices the claimed invention with the right to get a patent transferred from the original applicant (and similar situations for innovation businesses or other certified types), the examiner may confirm and recognize eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance determination for certified companies (venture/innovation/component/material/etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications filed by certified companies are entitled to expedited examination only when relevance between the claimed invention (or utility model) and the business type of the certified company is confirmed. Normally relevance is confirmed when the business type (from registration certificate or announcement) is the same as all or part of the industrial field of the claimed invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner uses registration certificates or announcement websites to compare industrial field; where relevance cannot be confirmed, order correction and request further explanation or documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inno-Biz — joint filing and identical-name rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Where an application is jointly filed and at least one applicant is designated as an Inno‑Biz, a request for expedited examination shall be recognized. Where names of the Inno‑Biz and the applicant are identical, the request shall be recognized; where names differ, only applications filed by companies certified as venture companies under 4.6 shall be eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify Inno‑Biz designation; if names differ and company is not also venture-certified, handle per venture rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inno-Biz — timing and documentary evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: At least at one point among filing date, request date, or determination date, an applicant shall constitute an Inno‑Biz. Documents to confirm Inno‑Biz shall be the original Inno‑Biz Confirmation issued by the Small & Medium Business Administration (copies acceptable if identical).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner should check dates and original confirmation; copies accepted only if demonstrably identical.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inno-Biz — relevance requirement and verification
rubrics_metrics.description: If there is no relevance between the business type of the Inno‑Biz and the claimed invention, the application shall not be eligible. Relevance shall be confirmed based on the requester’s explanation and evidential documents; examiner may compare business type and invention content on http://www.innobiz.net and may order correction if relevance is not confirmed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same practical steps as for venture businesses; order supplement when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Companies with outstanding employee invention compensation system — joint filing / identical name rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Where an application is jointly filed and at least one applicant is designated as a company with outstanding employee invention compensation system, a request for expedited examination shall be accepted. Only where the company title and applicant name are identical shall the request be accepted; where different, handle according to 'Applications related to Companies Certified as Venture Businesses'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow parallel procedures to venture-company rules when names differ.

rubrics_metrics.name: Companies with outstanding employee invention compensation system — timing and evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: The company shall constitute that status at least at one of: application date, request date, or determination date. Evidential document shall be the original 'Certificate of Company with Outstanding Employee Invention Compensation System' issued by KIPO; copies acceptable only if identical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner checks certificate and dates; accept copy only if demonstrably identical to original.

rubrics_metrics.name: Companies with outstanding employee invention compensation system — relevance determination
rubrics_metrics.description: If the business type of such a company is not relevant to the claimed invention, the request shall not be eligible. Relevance is determined based on evidential documents (business registration, etc.); where relevance cannot be identified, examiner shall order correction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same verification steps as other certified‑company categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications related to national new technology development support projects — subject identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications related to outcomes of national new technology development support projects filed based on outcomes of technology development under listed statutes/projects (industrial technological innovation, technological innovation projects, energy technology development, new & renewable energy, industrial convergence, ICT development, national R&D, sole‑proprietor creative business, and other government‑financed projects) are in scope.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determination of other projects can be made by each project; must be government‑financed. Examiner may consult the division in charge.

rubrics_metrics.name: National new technology projects — direct outcome requirement and institution confirmation
rubrics_metrics.description: To be recognized, applications shall be related to the direct outcome of the support projects. If direct relation is hard to determine but there are documents proving the application has been confirmed related to project outcomes by the institution in charge or participating institutions, the application shall be recognized as eligible for expedited examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accept institutional confirmation documents; examiner may require verification if relationship unclear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications related to national quality authentication projects (NeP/NeT/industrial convergence/etc.) — subject and definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications related to outcomes of national quality authentication projects (NeP new product authentication, NeT new technology authentication, industrial convergence product authentication, maritime/fisheries new technology, etc.) are subject. NeP authenticates products with great economic/technological impact; NeT authenticates technology with secured quantitative evaluation indexes and commercializable within two years; industrial convergence authenticates products created via cross‑industry/technology combination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certifications issued by designated Ministers/agencies; examiner may accept based on certification and project definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: National quality authentication projects — verification vs. presumptive acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: Where it is unclear that the claimed invention is the direct outcome of the certification project, examiner may order the requester to verify correlation. However, where the claimed invention is likely related to the direct outcome and there are no special grounds, examiner may recognize eligibility without further investigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner exercises discretion to accept where likelihood is high and no contrary grounds exist; otherwise require verification documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications forming basis of priority claim under treaty — eligibility rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications which form the basis of a priority claim under the Treaty and whose patent‑related proceeding is being conducted before foreign patent offices based on that priority claim may be eligible. Examiner must check that the foreign filing claims priority under the Paris Convention based on the Korean application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PCT applications based on a Korean application are recognized (except PCT self‑designation). Converted, divisional, or domestic‑priority applications based on the priority‑forming application are NOT themselves the basis and thus are not eligible for this ground.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT self‑designation special rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a PCT application is filed claiming priority based on a Korean application and it self‑designates the Republic of Korea, the prior‑filed Korean application may be deemed withdrawn after one year and three months, so a request for expedited examination on the prior‑filed application shall not be recognized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an expedited request was filed on the prior‑filed application, examiner shall order correction indicating the ground for rejection within the designated period; if the application under self‑designation is not withdrawn within the designated period, dismiss the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practiced or to be practiced by applicant — subject categories
rubrics_metrics.description: An application is deemed to have its claimed invention being practiced or to be practiced by the applicant where it falls under items such as: filed by a parts&materials‑specialized certified company for related inventions, or an invention awarded in an open contest/competition hosted by government where the invention is financially supported by the government for commercialization or patent filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certain certified company statuses or government‑supported awards can trigger this ground; check certification and financial support evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'practicing as a business'
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Practicing as a business' refers to practicing as running a business; personal/domestic practicing, education use, or one‑time experiments generally do not constitute business practicing. One‑time practicing for public interest may constitute business practicing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner must distinguish commercial/business exploitation from non‑commercial/educational/one‑time activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject of practicing: who qualifies as practicing
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant should practice or be practicing the invention. Even if the practicing entity is not an applicant, if the practicing entity engages in an agreement to practice the claimed invention with the applicant, the practicing is eligible for expedited examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evidence of agreements between applicant and third‑party practitioner supports eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determination: explanation and evidential documents required
rubrics_metrics.description: A requester shall explain that the claimed invention is being practiced (or prepared to be practiced) as a business in a written explanation and submit evidential documents. Examiner shall conduct expedited examination when submitted explanation and evidential documents confirm practicing or preparation to practice as a business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If documents and explanation are sufficient (see list), examiner recognizes practicing; otherwise order correction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidential documents that demonstrate practicing or preparation to practice as a business
rubrics_metrics.description: Evidential documents include, for example: business license; transaction sheet showing the product on sale is the claimed invention; delivery confirmation; purchase contract; product supply agreement; plant registration certificate; investment performance documents; loan issuance from bank; agreements indicating practicing details; lease‑rental agreements; evidential documents on component/material technology development business; and other relevant documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide multiple corroborating documents where possible (sales, contracts, investment, bank loans, prototype photos, catalogs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction field special evidentiary procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: For patent applications related to art that has requested accreditation as new technology in the construction field, the expedited examination request form should record a document management number and concerned art; if field‑applicability or test data is submitted as evidential document, the application shall be deemed practiced or to be practiced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner can verify accreditation via KAIA webpage (http://ct.kaia.re.kr). Field or test data can substitute as evidence of practicing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determination of identicalness between invention being practiced and claimed invention
rubrics_metrics.description: For requests based on practicing (or preparation to practice), the invention being practiced and the claimed invention shall be identical. Requester must prove identicalness. Examiner determines identicalness based on articles, photographs, or other evidential documents and the written explanation; if identicalness cannot be confirmed, order correction of the request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear side‑by‑side evidence (photos, specs, manuals) matching claimed features to the practiced product/process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition: component & material technology development business — automatic acceptance and evidentiary rules
rubrics_metrics.description: A request on an application filed by a company confirmed as a component & material technology development business shall be accepted as the invention being practiced or prepared to be practiced as a business without submission of the usual evidential documents. Relevancy between such businesses and the claimed invention shall be determined based on proving documents enclosed in the expedited request form and, if necessary, by referring to the Korea Institute for Advancement of Technology database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Joint filings where one applicant is such a confirmed company are accepted (subject to name and timing rules similar to other certified statuses). Original copy of the confirmation is evidential; copies acceptable if identical. Examiner may require supplements if relevancy cannot be checked.
